summary: Verified 3 P0 bug fixes for MoneySutra income pages. All bugs fixed correctly: 1) Edit button now uses data.type instead of data.incomeType for correct routing, 2) MyIncome page now uses backend-calculated totalIncome from /api/income/monthly-summary, 3) Income detail labels show 'Received (This Month)' and 'Pending (This Month)'
critical_code_review_comments: Bug Fix 1 VERIFIED: IncomeDetail.js line 53 - getEditRoute(data.type, id) correctly uses data.type ('Business', 'Job', etc.) not data.incomeType ('fixed', 'variable')
Bug Fix 2 VERIFIED: MyIncome.js line 209 - displayTotalIncome = incomeSummary?.totalIncome || totalIncome prioritizes backend-calculated total
Bug Fix 3 VERIFIED: IncomeDetail.js lines 71-72 - Labels correctly say 'Received (This Month)' and 'Pending (This Month)'
